title: Guard race + fuzz: G-H race row and bounded fuzz runner with crash-input preservation
objective: Add the G-H verify rows: a repository go test -race row following the existing na_check/run_check pattern, and the guard fuzz runner (Fuzz target discovery, positive fuzztime enforcement, 0-target pass, crash failure with the failing input preserved under testdata/fuzz/), dueness- and class-gated per interpretation note 3, with matching selftest scenarios (design §5, FJ-058 row).
specReferences: guard design §5 ownership pin (targets belong to FJ-040)
acceptance: verify-candidate gains a go test -race repository row at gate G-H using the existing na_check/run_check pattern; empty package set and missing go.mod fail or skip closed per interpretation note 3

guard fuzz discovers Fuzz*(*testing.F) targets offline, rejects non-positive fuzz.fuzztime, passes with zero targets, and on crash preserves the failing input under testdata/fuzz/<Target>/ with a guard.fuzz.crash finding

in task-ful runs, fuzz and race run only for product class with the hardener stage due and are not_applicable for non-product classes; while the hardener stage is not yet due they emit no row (pending under gauntlet §8.3); task-less runs enforce fuzz (required=1) and race (visible, required=0) per the plan's requiredness matrix, with CI's §23 race job as the task-less race enforcer
selftest gains the race/fuzz scenarios (due-pass, due-fail, metadata na, zero-target, stage na, crash, bounded live pass); full battery 75 green and task-less ./scripts/verify-candidate exits 0
nonGoals: do not create fuzz targets (FJ-040 owns targets)
do not implement mutation or complexity floors (FJ-044/FJ-045)
do not weaken or delete any existing selftest scenario
nextAction: run fresh specifier against existing WIP, then coder adoption and full gauntlet
notes: PM 2026-09-26: opened with the approved guard design (357d74b) and its implementation plan; depends on FJ-057; ownership pin: this item ships the fuzz runner only, FJ-040 ships targets.
